newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: RETAIL SALES 6.01 BLN LITAS IN H1 '97.
newsitem.headline: RETAIL SALES 6.01 BLN LITAS IN H1 '97.

text.p: Lithuania's retail sales, including sales at outdoor and farmers' markets, were 6.01 billion litas in the first half of 1997, the statistics department said on Tuesday.
Retail sales rose by 26.2 percent at constant prices and 16.7 percent at current prices compared to the same period in 1996, the sdepartment said in a statement.
The statement also said that in the first half of 1997 food products accounted for 38.1 percent of retail sales, alcohol and tobacco for 14.6 percent and non-food articles for 47.3 percent.
In the first six months of 1996 food products accounted for 43.3 percent of retail sales, tobacco and alcohol for 11.5 percent and non-food articles for 45.2 percent.
